name: fpr-lang
description: FP-RISC and Sol language support: compiler diagnostics on save, syntax highlighting, source-generated API hovers, completions, outlines, semantic tokens, and cross-module navigation.

fpr.home.description: Explicit module home (FPR_HOME). Leave empty for automatic per-project fprmeta/qosmeta selection. Setting a checkout home overrides managed SDK discovery.

fpr.modulePaths.description: Additional module roots, searched after the home (FPR_PATH).

fpr.check.description: Run the compiler on open and on save and show its errors (type, parse, safety, linearity, precondition, imports). .fpr files use `fpr compile --check-only`; .sol files compile to bytecode without running.

fpr.compilerPath.description: Explicit compiler or manager proxy. Empty: automatically follow project pins via fprmeta/qosmeta, then PATH and usual installed locations.

fpr.checkArgs.description: Compiler check flags. Empty: use the selected SDK target/prelude, or posix for ordinary FP-RISC. A nonempty list overrides automatic check flags.

fpr.unresolvedNames.description: Show informational squiggles for names the source scanner cannot resolve. This is best-effort, not compiler validation; dynamic record members and type-variable positions are excluded.

fpr.unsafeCalls.description: Underline statically resolved calls to functions declared unsafe, including blanket unsafe modules. Informational diagnostics; does not infer safety through dynamic function values.
